verdict.rationale: Bitwarden is a password manager and secrets vault. It does not host or define user automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is outside its product category. Its CLI, personal API key, Public API and MCP server are access surfaces that external scripts or agents call. Any automation logic lives in the user's own tooling, and nothing in the evidence shows Bitwarden storing, versioning or rolling back automation definitions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
